news.title: Global Jute Demand Surges as Single-Use Plastic Bans Tighten
news.excerpt: International markets across Europe and North America are accelerating procurement of Bangladeshi raw jute and biodegradable hessian textiles amidst strict regulatory ESG mandates.
news.content: International logistics and industrial packaging supply chains are witnessing a historic pivot toward sustainable natural fibers. Bangladesh, producing the world highest quality Golden Fiber, is positioned at the center of this transition.

news.title: Polymer Sourcing Strategies Amidst Freight Volatility
news.excerpt: An in-depth analysis of polymer indenting dynamics, petrochemical feedstock cycles, and practical risk mitigation for industrial converters in South Asia.
news.content: Navigating fluctuating crude oil benchmarks and international freight rates requires structured indenting agreements and disciplined inventory management.
